description: Fork of exp322 (joint qkv LUT, NAP=6, tph=256) bumping qkv_input_nap to 8. Same single TinyMHL produces q (n_out=2*d_qk:d_qk), k (d_qk:2*d_qk), v (2*d_qk:2*d_qk+d_v); RoPE on q,k pre-SDPA. table_dim 64 -> 256 (4x). Per-layer qkv params 15.7M -> 62.9M; 6 layers 94.4M -> 377M; total model 545M -> ~828M. Tests whether the +0.02 bpb gap between exp322 (joint NAP=6) and exp321 (separate, qk NAP=6 + v NAP=8) is recovered by adding capacity in the joint table — i.e., does shared anchor routing work given enough capacity?
